# Footnotes

Typesetting a page well takes patience.[^patience] Some notes are short,[^short] and a note can be reused by a second reference to the same label.[^short]

A reference with no definition stays as literal text.[^undefined]

A label defined twice keeps both definitions in source order.[^twice]

[^patience]: The first note has several parts.

    This is its second paragraph, indented under the label.

    ```
    code inside a note
    ```

[^short]: A short note.

[^twice]: First definition.

[^twice]: Second definition with the same label.

[^unused]: A definition that no paragraph references.
